name: comp-326
title: Sign In Dialog
description: A trigger opens a compact dark sign-in dialog with a ring icon, email and password fields, a Remember me checkbox, a Forgot password link, a white Sign in button and Login with Google.
use: Users should sign in without leaving the page they were on.
avoid: The form has no submit logic, so Sign in and Google do nothing as shipped.
a11y: Fields and the checkbox have bound labels, but there is no show-password control and no error handling. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Closed, an outlined Sign in button. Open, a narrow dark rounded dialog with a ring icon, a bold Welcome back title and grey subtitle, two labelled inputs, a Remember me checkbox with an underlined Forgot password? link, a white Sign in, an Or divider and an outlined Login with Google.
behaves: The trigger fades the dialog in, and Escape or the X closes it. Typing fills the fields and the checkbox ticks, but Sign in and Login with Google have no action.
customise: Labels, placeholders and both auth actions are fixed in the file; the component takes no props.
weight: light: One dialog with two inputs and a checkbox; no animation beyond the fade.
demo: The filled example uses maya@northwind.dev; placeholders are hi@yourcompany.com and Enter your password.
issues: Sign in and Login with Google have no handlers.
The password field cannot be revealed.
polishWhy: Clean, symmetrical login dialog with bound labels; submit actions are inert.
